birdwatch.auto.hint: Looks again while the tab is open. It stops when the plugin is switched off, and an account posts a few times a day, so the slower settings are usually the right ones.
birdwatch.description: Watches Bluesky accounts and drops their pictures into the intake folder Kibble sorts.
birdwatch.empty: Nothing yet. Add an account above and press Refresh. No login is needed: this reads the public feed of whoever you name.
birdwatch.handle.hint: A handle like someone.bsky.social, or a link to a profile or one of its posts.
birdwatch.intake.hint: Saved pictures land here, which is the same folder Saucer uses, so Kibble sorts them with everything else.
birdwatch.status.start: Add an account and press Refresh.
birdwatch.video.note: Bluesky serves video as a stream rather than a file, so there is nothing here to save. The link opens the post.
